targets.authors: Oliveira J, Franco F, Revers M, Silva A, Portolese J, Brentani H, et al.
targets.title: Computer-aided autism diagnosis based on visual attention models using eye tracking.
targets.evidence_quote: Taking this into account, the first contribution of this paper was to verify if the results obtained by the method proposed by Oliveira et al. [11] can be maintained in two different scenarios.
targets.outcome_quote: In summary, the results of the replication experiment were satisfactory, which suggests the robustness of the approach and the VAM-based approaches feasibility to aid in ASD diagnosis.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors give an overall satisfactory verdict on the replication experiment. They distinguish this from the trained-classifier transfer test, which required retraining. The lower replication AUC alone does not override the overall verdict.
